summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K containing its Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) and condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine quarterly earnings filing by a foreign private issuer, corresponding to a US quarterly report. It includes financial results, operational review, and non-GAAP measures but does not announce any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. No special situation event is present.
